slides.title: 1. What is GeoChat?
slides.html:
• TAK's integral GeoChat offers basic text communication.
  • Tap the Chat icon to start.

slides.title: 2. Showing Messages
slides.html:
• Initial screen shows any previous senders.
  • Select one to start.

slides.title: 4. Binding Quick Phrase Buttons
slides.html:
• To speed up communicating, you can bind Quick Phrase Buttons.
  • Long-tap one to start.

slides.title: 5. How-to: Quick Phrase
slides.html: • 'Name' is how it appears in the button. 'Value' is what the button will print.

slides.title: 6. Our Recommended Phrases
slides.html: • We recommend the following: Bind "This is YOUR CALLSIGN, ", "Roger", "Radio check", RC OK as "Loud and clear."

slides.title: 7. Navigate All Available Recipients
slides.html: • In the main geochat menu, hit the Plus symbol to see all available recipients.

slides.title: 8. Send to Roles
slides.html:
• Tapping HQ lets you send to all HQ-roled users in your Server.
  • This comes handy in our TAK Standard Usage Model where units communicate to CP users who are in the HQ role.

slides.title: 9. Send to Team
slides.html: • Sending to Team lets you send to a group of all eg. BLUE team users.

slides.title: 10. Send Direct Messages
slides.html: • Need to chat with just someone? Select them for the menu for that.

slides.title: 11. Send to Feed
slides.html: • Send to Feed eg. in case you're going to send an image to a Feed and want to explain why.

slides.title: Limitations of Geochat
slides.html:
There are three limitations with Geochat:

    1. Do not attempt to send images / attachments, this is not usable. Send them to a Feed instead.
    1. Recipient needs to have their TAK app open or in background to receive you.
    1. iTAK is unreliable with GeoChat group chat, especially with WinTAK <-> iTAK. For these reasons, we recommend to use Matrix (Element) for unit comms with Deploy App.

After successful testing GeoChat, continue to ATAK

slides.title: Check Read Status
slides.html:
• Each direct message shows a read tick: a filled white checkmark means the recipient has opened it, an unfilled one means delivered but not yet read.
  • The Messages list flags states like "sent to offline user" so you know if your message landed.

slides.title: Create or Add to a Group
slides.html:
• In Contacts, select the Group icon to make a new chat group of online and offline users; enter a group name and Select.
  • Pick Select an Existing Group to drop more users into a group you already have, even while they are offline.
